entries.title: The wiki-to-portal pipeline is built (switched off for now)
entries.done: Built the machinery that keeps the portal's plain-language text in step with the wiki: a rule book for Claude on how to write it, a shape for every portal file, a check script that spots outdated or missing text, and an automatic check at the end of each Claude turn. 20 tests pass. The automatic check stays off until the portal text exists.
entries.next: Claude writes the plain-language text for every page, then switches the automatic check on.

decisions.what: Portal text lives in plan/portal/, one file per portal tab, each with a fixed shape
Each record remembers the fingerprint of its wiki page, so outdated text is caught
Every id shown in the portal must have a short explainer popup
Check scripts go in scripts/verify (one per task) and scripts/gates (one per phase)
The end-of-turn check never blocks twice in a row and never traps a session if it breaks
